verdict: APPROVE — both round-2 devices reach paper exactly as specified and nothing else moved. The cover DESIGN CRITERIA line prints verbatim, 10px legible, exactly between the jurisdiction and date lines ('… @ 70 psf ground snow …' at VT, '… @ 50 psf …' at MN, absent at INTL/TX); the past-cap 90" RO prints 'ENGINEERED (by supplier)' in the B21d HEADER cell with '⚑ ENGINEERED BEAM REQUIRED — exceeds prescriptive header span' on the schedule row AND in the Flags block, the takeoff books it on the supplier pcs/lf rows (4x12 SKU excludes it: 5→4 pcs vs r1) and the member label confesses 'drawn as 4x12 — size by supplier' — no 4x12 lumber claim anywhere for that opening; the in-domain 70" RO still prints 4x12 with the full table label story at VT (and honestly 4x10 at MN, in the 50-band's 71" cell). Low-snow paper is byte-equal to master 779d70e file-for-file including dumps in all three variants; the pixel-diff vs round 1 is confined to the cover footer band + the flipped header cells/flags/takeoff-row-flow (demo-VT: cover ONLY; wall plan/elevations/section/foundation/electrical/MEP: zero diff pixels). The round-1 FAIL (FOCUS-2) flips to PASS; all five round-1 PASSes re-verified at the new pin. The B1 flag-precedence side effect is exact on paper (S7 compression aggregate 125→124 beside the +1 engineered row). Merge stamp.
